livespec.purpose: Classify each terminal dispatch as post-hoc Red, test-first, or unclassifiable, from the calibrated Red-to-Green gap median and the first-product-write-before-Red flag.

substitutions.__GAP_SECONDS__: HONEYCOMB_TDD_POST_HOC_GAP_SECONDS (default 120) — the Red-to-Green gap, in seconds, at or below which a cycle is read as post-hoc rather than genuinely test-first.

livespec.why_two_columns: The CLASSIFICATION column is what a human reads and what a board groups by; the FLAG column is what an aggregate needs, because a share is AVG of a 0/1 number and cannot be computed from a string. The flag deliberately REPEATS the condition rather than referencing the classification column, so neither definition depends on Honeycomb resolving a derived column from another derived column.
livespec.unclassifiable_is_not_clean: A dispatch with no observed Red count is 'unknown', never 'test-first'. The fields are omitted from the span when unobservable (see _dispatcher_tdd_signals), so EXISTS is the discriminator, and every share query below FILTERS unknown out rather than counting it as healthy.
livespec.live_validation_owed: The expression STRINGS below have not been accepted by the live Honeycomb API from the build sandbox — this slice provisions against a local API fixture only. Plan child bd-ib-i56nut owns the live leg. The one syntax risk to check first is the BARE DOTTED column reference ($tdd.red_commit_count): if the expression parser rejects it, re-try the same expression with each dotted reference wrapped as $"tdd.red_commit_count" and record which form the API accepted.

payloads.description: post-hoc | test-first | unknown. A dispatch is post-hoc when its first product write happened outside an open Red, or when the median Red-to-Green gap is at or below __GAP_SECONDS__ seconds. A dispatch with no observed Red count is unknown, not test-first.
1 when this dispatch classifies as post-hoc Red, else 0. AVG over dispatches filtered to tdd_post_hoc_red != unknown is the post-hoc Red SHARE the board and trigger read.
